justification: `src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Entities.java` is a 425-line utility class with 8 public static APIs and many helpers; it combines named-entity lookup (`isNamedEntity`, `getByName`, `findPrefix`), escaping (`escape`, `doEscape`, `appendEscaped`), unescaping, charset/XML validation, encoder caching, and table loading (`load`) in one unit. `src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/EntitiesData.java` only holds packed data, while `src/test/java/org/jsoup/nodes/EntitiesTest.java` exercises several distinct behaviors of the same class, reinforcing that `Entities` concentrates multiple responsibilities and could be split further.
